statusPolicy.rule: Only evidence supported by actual source inspection, dated test/build/deployment, physical-device result, qualified advice or elapsed observations advances the corresponding state. A partial implementation cannot pass an entire acceptance row.
statusPolicy.testRefsRule: A testRefs path identifies coverage to run. Only verificationEvidence supplies an actual dated result. Full acceptance remains pending while any criterion-specific gap exists.

acceptance.title: Reconcile and control the release
acceptance.requirement: One bill of materials matches source, deployed API/schema/web, distributed AAB and both installed test devices. Each transition has evidence.
acceptance.blockingGap: Populate one exact clean-SHA API/schema/web/AAB/deployed-config/installed-device BOM. No fresh distributed artifact, deployed inventory or both-phone match is recorded.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: BOM hashes source, migrations, dependency/licenses and supplied artifacts; missing runtime/device evidence fails readiness.

acceptance.title: Reconcile and control the release
acceptance.requirement: Old supported clients and the new client complete capture-to-retrieval against the intended API. An incompatible client fails before new recording and preserves pending work.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run old-supported and current actual clients end-to-end against the intended deployed API, including incompatible-client and pending-work upgrades.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: API capability contract and native/browser preflight preserve pending queues and reject incompatible capture.

acceptance.title: Reconcile and control the release
acceptance.requirement: CI proves concurrent uniqueness/finalization on real PostgreSQL; the assessment's 38-test subset and one skip are recorded as historical results only.
acceptance.blockingGap: Exact-source hosted PostgreSQL job must pass; local integration tests intentionally skip without PostgreSQL and cannot satisfy this criterion.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Required CI real PostgreSQL job uses independent pools for uniqueness, quota, commit/finalize/supplement and hold races. Historical assessment tests are not reused as current evidence.

acceptance.title: Reconcile and control the release
acceptance.requirement: A rehearsal deploy and rollback preserves committed records, signing access and runtime configuration. Branch protections are verified by an attempted prohibited change in a safe test context.
acceptance.blockingGap: Actual repository read on 2026-09-07 reports main unprotected and no rulesets. Connector access to detailed branch protection is denied and no administration mutation capability is available; cannot configure or verify a safely prohibited change. Deploy/rollback rehearsal and actual signing/config preservation evidence remain pending.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Release scripts preserve runtime inputs; operations runbook and source-SHA guard describe additive-schema rollback.

acceptance.title: Preserve the canonical evidence model
acceptance.requirement: Concurrent creates resolve to one transaction Proof; duplicate/retried commits and finalizations produce one logical result and unchanged bytes.
acceptance.blockingGap: Obtain exact-source real PostgreSQL concurrency results; PGlite and test source alone do not prove deployed role behavior.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Canonical transaction uniqueness, idempotent evidence and immutable final-manifest paths have concurrency tests.

acceptance.title: Preserve the canonical evidence model
acceptance.requirement: Updating or deleting committed evidence, rewriting external identity, or changing a finalized manifest is rejected for sellers, clients and ordinary service roles.
acceptance.blockingGap: Apply and verify actual runtime grants, including denied ALTER/TRUNCATE/mutation on the intended database.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Database triggers and domain guards freeze committed evidence, external identity and finalized core; runtime-role SQL separates migration authority.

acceptance.title: Preserve the canonical evidence model
acceptance.requirement: A later parcel/return/correction changes the current projection and supplement head while the original manifest digest remains identical. Old exports still verify as dated snapshots.
acceptance.blockingGap: Full later parcel/return allocation workflows remain outside the single-parcel pilot. Run final exact-source archive/verification checks with the deployed independent trust registry; independently obtain a current head when completeness is needed. A received valid prefix alone cannot prove absence of later records.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Signed append-only supplements change their received snapshot head without rewriting the finalized core. Canonical portable archives freeze proof-supplements.json and its received sequence/head descriptor; Python independently checks exact canonical bytes, ordered hashes, core binding, each signature and dated external trust. Earlier downloaded snapshots remain verifiable and explicitly cannot establish that no later supplements exist.

acceptance.title: Preserve the canonical evidence model
acceptance.requirement: Label swap, reused recording, similar-item substitution, reopening after recording and contradictory returns are tested and classified as detected, documented or unresolved. Reuse detection is restricted to authorized scope; a hash match alone is not an accusation.
acceptance.blockingGap: Verify the exact final-source scenario suite and released labels. Physical attacks/detection accuracy remain explicitly unestablished; no overall fraud-free, item-authenticity or unbroken-custody claim is permitted.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Five executed adversarial fixtures classify label conflict and digital replacement as detected, authorized digest equality and attributed contradictory statements as documented, and unseen physical substitution/reopening/causation as unresolved. Unauthorized matching media remain undisclosed; hash equality creates no accusation.

acceptance.title: Bound media admission, memory and cost
acceptance.requirement: An oversized upload is refused before the storage contract admits bytes beyond its allowed bound. Forged size/type, excess parts, duplicate admissions and expired contracts cannot bypass tenant quotas. Replaying the same upload credential or replacing the same multipart part cannot create unbounded cumulative ingress cost.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run required PostgreSQL races and deployed ingress/storage tests proving proxy limits, direct-upload bypass denial and tenant/account quota mapping.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Atomic per-account reservations, declared-length gateway, expiring one-use credentials and failed-attempt cumulative charging bound ingress before storage.

acceptance.title: Bound media admission, memory and cost
acceptance.requirement: A 1 MB range from a 100 MB object reads approximately the requested range, with measured bounded overhead. Increasing object size does not make process memory grow by the object size.
acceptance.blockingGap: Repeat bounded-range/RSS checks with deployed object transport and increasing object sizes under actual container limits; local filesystem/PGlite observation is not cloud capacity evidence.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Pinned-version streaming returned and read exactly 1,048,576 bytes from a 100,000,000-byte synthetic object, in chunks at most 65,536 bytes; local before/after API RSS differed by 73,728 bytes. Full preservation hashing is streamed.

acceptance.title: Bound media admission, memory and cost
acceptance.requirement: At an initial 10 simultaneous playbacks, two commits and two exports, measured worker memory stays below 70% of its configured limit, no process is killed and queued work remains recoverable. These are starting load gates, not claimed production capacity.
acceptance.blockingGap: Local starting load check passed at verified clean source commit 73ef9b31a680f3d3a67fbd1eed5608cd98ea7692 with 1,923 valid samples and observed child processes. Repeat under kernel-enforced 1 GiB/0.25-vCPU deployment limits and actual external services. Shared-host local PGlite/filesystem evidence does not close deployed operational acceptance.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Actual local HTTP load completed 10 full playbacks, two streamed commits and two four-frame exports with zero abnormal load exits. Measured API plus children peak RSS was 319,172,608 bytes; conservative concurrent high-water sum was 333,725,696 bytes (31.08% of the fixed 1,024 MiB configured target). Separate real worker SIGKILL and normal expired-lease claim recovered the queued export on attempt 2.

acceptance.title: Bound media admission, memory and cost
acceptance.requirement: Expired staging is removed; committed/held media survives the same sweep, upload-URL reuse and a lost commit response. Readability passes consented item/label checks after capture settings are tuned.
acceptance.blockingGap: Verify separate live bucket/maintenance policies, Object Lock behavior and sweep retention, then conduct consented item/label readability checks on tuned device recordings.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Expired staging cleanup is isolated from committed keys; exact version pinning preserves accepted bytes; failed cleanup remains visible.

acceptance.title: Make capture completion recoverable
acceptance.requirement: Force-stop, airplane mode, low storage, app backgrounding, expired auth and lost responses at every boundary preserve a recoverable journal and avoid duplicate logical writes.
acceptance.blockingGap: Exercise force-stop, low storage, airplane mode, lifecycle/auth/lost-response matrix on both physical phones and browsers. Earlier hosted native compilation/debug APK passes are historical; exact code-36 source must be rebuilt and its artifact BOM verified.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Account-scoped protected-file/native-marker journal, shared completion coordinator, persisted browser queue and idempotent server recovery cover modeled interruption boundaries.

acceptance.title: Make capture completion recoverable
acceptance.requirement: Neither platform calls a local-only file “preserved by PackProof.” A database-committed record awaiting durability is not labeled preserved; a durably preserved but unfinalized record has a distinct, truthful state.
acceptance.blockingGap: Complete exact-release visual/task checks on Android and Packing Station; do not expose strict preservation until independently protected publisher is configured.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Shared status distinguishes local, database committed/pending durability, durable/unfinalized and finalized; stage evidence selects its own receipts.

acceptance.title: Make capture completion recoverable
acceptance.requirement: Reauthentication resumes the original capture without retake. Wrong-account access is denied. Deliberate discard confirms the consequence and never deletes committed server evidence.
acceptance.blockingGap: Verify real account-switch/expired-auth/discard flows through both deployed clients, including restart and unavailable storage.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Reauthentication resumes durable local original under original account; mismatched account cannot write/discard; confirmed local discard does not delete committed server bytes.

acceptance.title: Make capture completion recoverable
acceptance.requirement: Android and Packing Station show the same final status for the same record and recover interrupted completion without founder assistance.
acceptance.blockingGap: Unassisted physical Android and Packing Station recovery of the same record must be observed with matched release identity.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Android/provider and browser station use common logical completion states; central browser retry survives screen changes.

acceptance.title: Complete biometric seller attestation
acceptance.requirement: Active-challenge retry/concurrency, replay, wrong account/Proof/video/statement/key, expired nonce and concurrent challenge consumption cannot create a new or misbound declaration.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run the complete current challenge and concurrent-consumption suite plus native-to-API binding on exact release; historical biometric results do not transfer automatically.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Signed challenge binds account/Proof/evidence/statement/key/nonce and transactional consumption; accepted-result retries retain declaration identity.

acceptance.title: Complete biometric seller attestation
acceptance.requirement: Lost-response retry retrieves the accepted declaration and completes the same Proof. Changed enrollment, lockout, cancellation and missing enrollment preserve the recording.
acceptance.blockingGap: Test changed enrollment, lockout, cancellation and lost responses on both actual phone models and the deployed API.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Client retains original/completion intent through biometric cancel/enrollment/unavailability; accepted authorization recovers without creating a new declaration.

acceptance.title: Complete biometric seller attestation
acceptance.requirement: Both phones pass the supported strong-biometric flow. TalkBack announces the full statement and action. Raw biometric data is absent from app-owned files, requests, telemetry and exports.
acceptance.blockingGap: Rebuild exact code-36 Kotlin/APK and inspect both-phone strong-biometric/TalkBack behavior, files/requests/telemetry/export traces. Earlier native build success does not prove the latest artifact or either physical phone.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Native strong-biometric-only crypto prompt and full accessible statement action exist; app transports signatures rather than biometric templates.

acceptance.title: Complete biometric seller attestation
acceptance.requirement: App, API, guest Proof and export agree on declaration text, signer account attribution and verification scope. No surface calls this legal identity verification or a delivery signature.
acceptance.blockingGap: Complete cross-surface released output comparison, including guest/export historical verification and absence of legal-identity/delivery-signature overclaims.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Exact seller declaration and scoped account attribution are available across API, signed record and accessible confirmation surfaces.

acceptance.blockingGap: Implement and test full split/multi-parcel, partial-fulfillment, replacement and relabel allocation/history before expanding support. acceptance.implementedBehavior: Provider/order adapter and periodic reconciliation implementation are retained; dated integration record states supported pilot scope.

acceptance.title: Match orders, parcels and live tracking

acceptance.implementedBehavior: Shippo hints are coalesced and authenticated refetch imports facts; replay keys and scheduled reconciliation handle missed visits.

acceptance.title: Match orders, parcels and live tracking
acceptance.priority: P1, with safe matching required for G1
acceptance.requirement: UI/export distinguish source, test/live environment, label observation, provider possession, delivery and unavailable data. Retain a dated integration evidence record.

acceptance.implementedBehavior: Label observation, accepted association, source and sandbox/live provenance remain distinct in canonical records/export profiles.

acceptance.blockingGap: Run S24 Ultra and A16 5G navigation/keyboard/long-record/playback/expansion matrix on the exact AAB.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Scroll restoration and coordinated keyboard/list behavior have source regressions; physical matrix is written.

acceptance.title: Deliver one calm, consistent interface
acceptance.priority: P0 recovery/accessibility slice; P1 full refinement
acceptance.requirement: Back restores the same visible record anchor without a visible jump after refresh. Actions remain responsive during upload and no duplicate submit is caused by absent feedback.
acceptance.blockingGap: Observe no visible jump on both phones after refresh, nested return and concurrent upload; source layout tests cannot establish perceptual behavior.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Stable record anchor restoration and responsive progress/central recovery prevent duplicate logical completion in source tests.

acceptance.title: Deliver one calm, consistent interface

acceptance.requirement: TalkBack, keyboard-only web use, 200% text, contrast, reduced motion, permission denial and low-storage recovery pass the entire core task. Status never depends only on color or icon. Debounced haptics behave correctly on both phones, including disabled system haptics. Provide participant-authored or verified text context for recording content, and captions where speech is needed to understand it; retain author/source attribution. Optional generated captions remain labeled and reviewable under W17.

acceptance.implementedBehavior: Semantic status, accessible confirmation, light station, haptic preference respect and attributed participant text context exist in source.

acceptance.title: Deliver one calm, consistent interface
acceptance.priority: P0 recovery/accessibility slice; P1 full refinement
acceptance.requirement: Uncoached new sellers identify the right order, complete a usable Proof and explain preserved versus pending status; W15 supplies the quantitative activation and effort gates.
acceptance.blockingGap: Enroll consented uncoached sellers, record first-use success/failures and effort, and evaluate W15 thresholds.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Capture coaching, preflight and usability protocol expose eligible order and truthful preservation states.

acceptance.requirement: Selected channel outputs pass actual size/count/type/page constraints and contain the facts without opening external links. Boundary tests include one byte/file/page over the limit.

acceptance.implementedBehavior: Versioned fresh eBay/Stripe profiles validate actual encoded type/bytes/files/pages; facts/stills are embedded and boundary tests include over-limit cases.

acceptance.title: Turn Proofs into accepted, usable submissions
acceptance.requirement: Frame offsets, evidence IDs, approved text and digests resolve to the unchanged original. Modifying a draft after approval invalidates approval; downloading repeats the approved bytes.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run exact-source export/API/browser approval suite and retain a verified released package linking each derivative to its unchanged original.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Recipient jobs freeze source IDs, frame offsets, text, profile and artifact digest; approval binds preview bytes and repeat downloads revalidate stored hashes.

acceptance.title: Turn Proofs into accepted, usable submissions
acceptance.requirement: Destination acceptance, image legibility, reviewer comprehension and handling improvement are measured separately. Actual case portals are tested only through consented/authorized cases; no fabricated real disputes.
acceptance.blockingGap: Conduct consented authorized portal submissions and randomized reviewer tasks; no fabricated dispute or automatic acceptance claim.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Export status explicitly leaves portal acceptance untested; research schema separates technical acceptance, legibility, comprehension and handling effort.

acceptance.title: Turn Proofs into accepted, usable submissions
acceptance.requirement: Missing delivery or address-match evidence for an item-not-received issue is explicit. PayPal eligibility is never implied by a PackProof export; its protection terms and exclusions are separate. [S3]
acceptance.blockingGap: Review exact released missing-evidence examples against applicable destination instructions; legal/protection eligibility is not certified.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Factual evidence-gap display keeps absent delivery/address facts explicit and does not infer recipient eligibility from an export.

acceptance.title: Enforce neutral access, sharing and counter-evidence
acceptance.requirement: Cross-tenant/object-ID access, expired/revoked links, unauthorized exports and forged invitations fail. Cache and media-token tests honor the documented revocation window.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run full exact-source tenant/object/link/token matrix and measure revocation through actual ingress/caches and long media responses.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Participant/tenant/grant checks, immutable revocation, scope migration, no-store responses and active-stream authorization checkpoints close source access boundaries.

acceptance.title: Enforce neutral access, sharing and counter-evidence
acceptance.requirement: Buyer evidence cannot be edited or silently suppressed from a full authorized record by the payer. Partial views/export previews identify scope and omissions without leaking restricted content.
acceptance.blockingGap: Verify released full/partial record and export views with conflicting authorized counter-evidence and sensitive omitted material.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Buyer/recipient append-only supplements preserve source attribution; disclosure selections state scope and old grants do not gain statement rights.

acceptance.title: Enforce neutral access, sharing and counter-evidence
acceptance.requirement: Repeated buyer requests resolve to one request relationship and at most one canonical Proof. Declining/ignoring a request produces no adverse truth claim or charge without the agreed trigger.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run exact-source request/API/UI tests and confirm actual consented seller/buyer comprehension; no automatic buyer media grant is inferred.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Normalized buyer request relation dedupes, seller acceptance binds an existing canonical Proof, and decline/expiry create neither charge nor adverse truth claim.

acceptance.title: Enforce neutral access, sharing and counter-evidence
acceptance.requirement: A recipient can view permitted evidence and contribute an attributed response without changing the seller's finalized manifest. Support access is attributable and reviewable.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run exact-release support/recipient HTTP and deployed-role/access tests, review actual support audit and verify real recipient comprehension. No support role is enabled without explicit configuration.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Attributed recipient supplements preserve seller core; support requires an explicit separate approver, named reader, reviewed issue/reason, narrow metadata or selected evidence, maximum one-hour expiry, immutable grant/revocation/read audit and active-stream reauthorization.

acceptance.title: Close security and infrastructure boundary gaps
acceptance.requirement: Invalid/untrusted database certificates fail; a supported CA rotation succeeds. Runtime privilege tests prove denied schema and committed-evidence mutation operations.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run actual invalid/rotated CA connections and disposable runtime privilege-denial tests with intended deployment roles.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Hosted database TLS verifies hostname/chain, URL flags cannot weaken policy, schema checksum validation and separate runtime-role SQL exist.

acceptance.title: Close security and infrastructure boundary gaps
acceptance.requirement: Spoofed forwarded headers cannot choose rate-limit identity. Two real viewers behind ingress are treated correctly; multi-replica abuse limits remain effective.
acceptance.blockingGap: Exercise two distinct viewers behind intended ingress and concurrent real replicas; record proxy identity and effective limit evidence.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Trusted-proxy configuration is explicit and distributed database limits share replica identity; forwarded-header spoofing has source regressions.

acceptance.title: Close security and infrastructure boundary gaps
acceptance.requirement: Independent testing closes critical preservation/access findings, with scoped evidence for residual risks, owner, mitigation and revisit date. No blanket security certification is claimed.
acceptance.blockingGap: Obtain independent scoped preservation/access testing and named owner/mitigation/revisit evidence for residual findings.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Source review findings are fixed or scoped in release docs; no independent certification is asserted.

acceptance.title: Close security and infrastructure boundary gaps
acceptance.requirement: Secret and dependency scans, manual tenant isolation checks, export parser limits and support-access review complete for the release candidate, with failures linked to blocked gates.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run scans on exact candidate; residual mobile image-size advisory stays visible and blocks default high-severity gate until accepted mitigation or upstream fix. Complete manual tenant/support review and deployed sandbox limits.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: CI runs high/critical dependency audits, redacted history secret scan, parser-boundary tests and mobile patch guards; BOM records licenses/missing metadata.

acceptance.title: Make operations observable and recovery provable

acceptance.requirement: With no incoming user traffic, uploads/exports/provider reconciliation still progress or alert. Expired leases and duplicate jobs recover once logically.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run isolated deployed worker with zero HTTP traffic, kill/expire leases and confirm useful progress plus real alerts.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Independent schedules advance core/policy receipts, provider sync, exports, notifications and usage; leases and heartbeat/useful-completion diagnostics distinguish stall/error.

acceptance.title: Make operations observable and recovery provable
acceptance.dependencies: W01–W03, W10, W12 approved policy slice
acceptance.requirement: A restore drill meets measured RTO/RPO and reconciles every acknowledged test receipt around the backup boundary. Crash each receipt-protocol boundary, conflict an envelope and attempt a stale writer; no premature preserved/finalized status is emitted. Any loss or coverage gap is explicit and blocks a zero-loss assurance.
acceptance.blockingGap: Complete recovery of non-core integration/billing/study metadata and post-last-core audit events, plus controlled service cutover; these are unfinished implementation, not only missing drill evidence. Then run exact-source PostgreSQL/protected-store backup-boundary reconciliation and measure RTO/RPO. The implemented core/policy importer deliberately leaves reads/writers fenced and cannot support full-service restore or zero-loss claims.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Conditional signed core receipts and separate policy watermark, stale-writer fence, closed policy replay and fresh isolated database reconstruction are implemented; exact retained media/journal versions and historical signatures are checked before inserting accepted rows.

acceptance.title: Make operations observable and recovery provable
acceptance.dependencies: W01–W03, W10, W12 approved policy slice
acceptance.requirement: Rotated and revoked historical signatures are assessed under an explicit dated trust policy offline, with stale/unknown revocation knowledge disclosed; a package cannot establish trust merely by including its own untrusted public key.
acceptance.blockingGap: Run current offline verifier suite against exported historical packages and publish the actual independently distributed dated trust registry.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Portable Python verifier checks root and each received supplement against independently signed dated trust; key rotation, retired/revoked/compromised/unknown/stale knowledge are explicit. Including a key or old valid chain cannot self-establish trust or current completeness.

acceptance.title: Make operations observable and recovery provable
acceptance.dependencies: W01–W03, W10, W12 approved policy slice
acceptance.requirement: Operator drills cover compromised credentials, missing/decryption-inaccessible media, failed deployment and stalled exports. Another operator can follow the runbook without relying on founder memory.
acceptance.blockingGap: Assign a second operator and execute each drill without founder assistance; record actual timings, authority boundaries and unavailable-key recovery.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Operational CLI and runbook specify credential compromise, unavailable exact media, failed release, export stalls and rollback.

acceptance.title: Align retention, rights and commercial trust

Race hold creation against disposal and prove no accepted hold loses its protected versions. Existing commitments are never shortened silently.

The plan deliberately sequences destructive automation after approved policy and successful restore validation. Preserve closed gates; then verify PostgreSQL hold races, restored-backup exact versions and actual cleanup controls.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Versioned retention assignment, non-shortening policy, missing-anchor/active-case gates and hold/disposition shared lock fail closed; policy recovery covers holds.

acceptance.title: Align retention, rights and commercial trust

acceptance.title: Align retention, rights and commercial trust

No charge or invoice-creation action is enabled by the current adapter.

Optional disabled Stripe adapter verifies HMAC/account/environment/version and financial records, dedupes payments/refunds/reversal legs, reads own invoices and creates only an explicitly requested cancellation-review portal. Daily provider event scanning persists cursor/lease, 48-hour overlap and failed/unordered events; explicit baseline/30-day history gaps remain visible. Approved pricing requires a matching independently pinned publication receipt. Weekly financial input represents refund reversals as separately linked positive legs, validates their earlier refund basis even outside the cost period, rejects repeat reversal identities, accumulates exact net amounts and never infers charges or payers.

acceptance.title: Price one standard and measure full unit economics
acceptance.dependencies: W03, W12 approved offer/policy, W15 metric dictionary; observed cost results follow billing
acceptance.requirement: One real billing period reconciles payments, costs, failed attempts and support with unexplained differences flagged. No invented current margin or operating bill is reported.

Configured daily event scanning alone is not full financial reconciliation.
acceptance.implementedBehavior: Metrics require actual cost-source references, full categories, elapsed period and zero unexplained reconciliation difference; empty input reports unknown contribution. Configured provider daily scanning is independent of HTTP and never equates scan completion with invoice/cost reconciliation. Weekly financial input represents refund reversals as separately linked positive legs, validates their earlier refund basis even outside the cost period, rejects repeat reversal identities, accumulates exact net amounts and never infers charges or payers.

acceptance.title: Price one standard and measure full unit economics
